source_review_findings: VM0007 dependency references are governed at component identity level unless the methodology source itself pins a version; local exact-version PDFs are support artifacts and are not silently promoted into source version semantics.
VMD0007/BL-UP is incorporated by reference when the relevant unplanned-deforestation rule applies; the source rule does not establish v3.3 as a VM0007-pinned version.
VM0047 is an informative example of an appropriate ARR methodology in the source, not a mandatory VM0047 dependency.
T-SIG resolves to the methodology's internal Appendix 1 significance procedure and is not modeled as a standalone external component dependency.
merge_gate: The authoritative governance artifact and its validator must pass the repository stage-gates before this migration is mergeable.
